# Brain Blog

> Articles, tutorials and reflections on AI and software by Marco Netto (tchez), in English and Portuguese.

The author's site, with his projects, papers and talks, is https://tchez.dev/ (summary for AI readers: https://tchez.dev/llms.txt).

## Posts (English)

- [From Data to Knowledge: The Power of Vector Databases](https://blog.tchez.dev/vector-database/): vector databases, embeddings and similarity search, and how they store knowledge rather than only data.
- [Do you know what magic methods are in Python? Hint: You use them every day!](https://blog.tchez.dev/dunder-methods/): Python's magic (dunder) methods, what they are for and how to use them.
- [Welcome to Brain Blog](https://blog.tchez.dev/welcome/): what the blog is and what to expect.

## Posts (Português)

- [Como armazenar conhecimento com bancos de dados vetoriais?](https://blog.tchez.dev/pt/vector-database/): bancos de dados vetoriais, embeddings e busca por similaridade.
- [Você sabe o que são métodos mágicos em Python? Dica: Você usa todos os dias!](https://blog.tchez.dev/pt/dunder-methods/): os métodos mágicos (dunder) do Python.
- [Bem-vindo ao Brain Blog](https://blog.tchez.dev/pt/welcome/): o que é o blog.
